title: News
lead: Parish news: announcements, reports, invitations. Write in French; English is optional.
empty_p: Write the first one: a welcome, an announcement, a report.
title_ph: The title shown on the site
excerpt_ph: One or two sentences for the list and for sharing. Otherwise the start of the text is used.
en_note: Optional. If you leave English empty, English-speaking visitors see the French version with a note.
side_group_help: A group leader can only write for their own group.
side_slug_help: Created automatically from the title, always unique; it no longer changes once the post is published.
side_pin: Pin at the top of the list
preview_help: A secret link, valid for 3 days, to show the draft to someone without an account.
delete_p: This is permanent, including earlier versions. Archiving is often enough.
archive_p: It leaves the site but stays here, and you can make it a draft again.
unpublish_p: It becomes a draft again. A link already shared will show nothing.

site.empty_p: The first news is coming soon. You will read it here and be able to share it by WhatsApp in one tap.
site.unavailable_t: The news is not loading right now
site.unavailable_p: This is not your fault. Please try again in a moment.
site.fallback_note: This text does not exist in English yet: here is the French version.
site.not_found_t: This news post does not exist (any more)
site.not_found_p: It may have been taken off the site. The other news is waiting for you.
site.preview_banner: Preview: this page is not published yet. The link is temporary.
